lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.4% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests while 3 showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests, underestimating their actual performance.
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that showed no clear effect or performed poorly.

candidates.title: Spotlight layout redesign for home intro
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight layout showcasing desktop pet interactions before finishing onboarding.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is highest (64.8% conversion, mean time 5815s) and users reported confusion on how to interact with desktop pets.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet
home_intro.body: Your companion lives on your screen. Learn how to interact, minimize, or customize them.

guard.reason: Redesign of home intro layout remains within onboarding limits and preserves screen job.

candidates.score_note: Target step finish has highest drop-off, but full screen redesigns have consistently underperformed or lowered conversion.

candidates.title: Pet personality traits selection screen
candidates.change: Insert a new pet personality trait selection screen into the adoption flow before picking or customizing a pet.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.8% with long completion time (mean 1017s); interactive trait selection increases user engagement.

new_personality_traits.headline: Choose Pet Personality
new_personality_traits.body: Select unique traits for your desktop pet companion.

guard.reason: home_intro must come after every existing screen, sign_in included

candidates.title: Notify when ready toggle on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add a system notification toggle and estimated time remaining indicator on the pet generation waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step during pet generation takes mean 2336s, leading to abandonment while pet model assets generate.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet...
waiting.body: We are generating your 3D pet assets. You can close or minimize this window.

guard.reason: Time estimate indicator during real wait time is allowed under Rule 5 and waiting screen job is preserved.

candidates.score_note: Addresses major home wait time friction, though home changes have shown mixed baseline performance.

candidates.title: Two-column layout redesign for pick friend
candidates.change: Redesign the pick friend screen to a two-column layout with side-by-side pet previews and detail cards.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 70.8%; grid layout was stopped, but a two-column layout provides clearer pet selection comparisons.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet friend to bring onto your desktop.

guard.reason: Layout redesign for pick friend screen preserves pet selection job and steps.

candidates.score_note: Target drop-off is high, but adoption redesign previously dropped conversion by -8.0%.

candidates.title: Path selection clarity headline and hint
candidates.change: Clarify path selection headlines and add a helpful hint explaining that additional pets can be added later.
candidates.why: Path selection has mean 514s completion time and 80.6% conversion, showing hesitation between premade vs photo path.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Adoption Path
choose_path.body: Choose between ready-to-adopt pets or create a custom pet from photos.
choose_path.hint: You can adopt additional pets anytime from settings later.

guard.reason: Clarifying copy and adding a hint on choose path screen maintains both adoption options and avoids price references.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change targeting user hesitation with positive precedent on choose_path step.

candidates.title: Photo submission tips on upload screen
candidates.change: Add a interactive photo quality tip carousel component to the photo upload screen to guide custom pet image uploads.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet photo generation failures or poor output quality during creation.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Provide clear, well-lit photos of your pet for best 3D generation.

guard.reason: Adding photo tip carousel component to photo upload screen is valid design enhancement inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail alignment and previous adoption new_flow test showed +3.0% gain.

candidates.title: Account sync progress badge on sign in screen
candidates.change: Add a visual progress badge on the sign-in screen reassuring users that their pet adoption data is being saved.
candidates.why: 8 support emails noted missing pets after re-authenticating; visual feedback reinforces that sign-in preserves pet data.

guard.reason: Adding a progress saved badge to sign in screen is valid within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from 8 support tickets; sign_in step optimization generally shows positive results.

candidates.title: Desktop interaction hint on home intro screen
candidates.change: Add a clear hint to the home intro screen detailing drag-and-drop and right-click desktop overlay controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets complained about confusion controlling, hiding, or talking to the desktop pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Drag your pet anywhere on your desktop, or right-click them to access controls and chat.

guard.reason: Adding desktop interaction hints to home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High impact step with clear evidence from 3 support tickets, addressed via low-cost hint rather than risky redesign.

candidates.title: Move sign-in screen before path selection
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after the initial story screen and before path selection.
candidates.why: 8 users emailed about missing/reset pets after re-authenticating late in the onboarding flow; early sign-in prevents account loss.

guard.reason: sign_in may move later, not before choose_path

candidates.title: Compact layout for sign-in screen
candidates.change: Switch the sign-in screen to a compact layout to reduce visual friction and speed up account creation.
candidates.why: Sign-in takes median 3s but mean 567s with occasional stalls reported by users; compact layout streamlines input.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet
sign_in.body: Connect your account so your desktop companion is always saved.

guard.reason: Compact layout update for sign in screen retains screen job and compliance rules.

candidates.score_note: Targets sign_in latency backed by sign_in reorder success trends (+4.4%).
